I choose to stay and experience the totality of this reality - the good and the bad, together. I do so because i suspect this opportunity is indeed an extremely rare and valuable one, despite the pain that comes with it. There is also the Lulz - and you should not forget that. I have my time here and it is not forever, so I try to make the best of it, and play the game with the cards that are dealt. It is always possible to win, even with a shitty hand.

I cannot speak for you, nor will I. The choices you make belong to you. I can only say that I have learned a truth about this place - no matter your situation today, it is entirely possible that tomorrow will turn out to be very different. Everything changes, all the time, whether you want it to or not.

If you do decide to stay, I recommend you deliberately choose to focus on the happiness. The more time you spend in the darkness, the stronger that darkness becomes, the same is true for the light. To strengthen the light you have to force yourself into it - the longer you remain there, the stronger it becomes. This is not BS - it's neural scientific fact - it's how our brains work, and that regulates our conscious experience of this place. Happiness is not just an experience - it is a strategy, a tactic, a training regime, a weapon. You have to deliberately choose it, until you become one with contentment.

In the long tale of my own suffering I have discovered another truth - it is the crippled hunchbacks, the maimed, limbless, lost people, that have the strongest souls of us all. When people like this find happiness, they become the most powerful of us all. Perhaps that is the reason why you are really here. Perhaps that is why I am here now to tell you this.

You know, I look back upon my victories and I value them greatly - because I know just how hard they were to achieve. I know exactly what I am made of, the good, the bad, and the ugly, and I know exactly just how formidable I have become.
